ei.subject: 2026년 3월 고2 모의고사
ei.title: Agricultural Land Use and Global Food Demand

fullPassage:
Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant.
(A) Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991.
(B) It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology.
(C) Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor. However, the growing global population will always demand more food.

questions.passage: (A)[Archaeological / Architectural] evidence suggests that various crops were being (B)[cultivated / eliminated] as early as 9500 BC in the (C)[Levant / Atlantic].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 고고학적(Archaeological) 증거에 따르면 다양한 작물이 기원전 9500년에 레반트(Levant)에서 재배(cultivated)되고 있었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② Archaeological — cultivated — Levant: 원문과 일치
❌ ① Architectural(건축학적): 다른 분야
❌ ③ eliminated(제거된): cultivated의 반의어
❌ ④ Atlantic(대서양): 지역이 다름
det.tip: archaeological(고고학적), cultivated(재배된), Levant(레반트, 지중해 동부)

questions.passage: Over the millennia, continuous (A)[innovations / restrictions] have boosted agricultural (B)[productivity / pollution] while reducing manual (C)[labor / profit].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 수천 년에 걸쳐 지속적인 혁신(innovations)이 농업 생산성(productivity)을 높이면서 수작업 노동(labor)을 줄였다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① innovations — productivity — labor: 원문과 일치
❌ ② restrictions(제한): innovations의 반의어
❌ ③ pollution(오염): productivity와 다름
❌ ④ profit(이익): labor와 다른 개념
det.tip: innovation(혁신), productivity(생산성), manual labor(수작업 노동)

questions.passage: It is (A)[projected / denied] that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion. Despite this need, only a small (B)[portion / majority] of the Earth's surface is (C)[suitable / harmful] for farming.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 2050년까지 세계 인구가 97억으로 증가할 것으로 전망(projected)된다. 지구 표면의 작은 부분(portion)만이 농업에 적합(suitable)하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ projected — portion — suitable: 원문과 일치
❌ ① denied(부정된): projected의 반의어
❌ ② majority(대다수): portion(소부분)의 반의어
❌ ④ harmful(해로운): suitable의 반의어
det.tip: projected(전망된), a small portion(작은 부분), suitable for(~에 적합한)

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC. Over the millennia, continuous ①<u>innovations</u> have boosted agricultural ②<u>productivity</u>. However, the growing global population will always ③<u>reduce</u> more food. Political and economic factors also ④<u>influence</u> agricultural land use.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ reduce(줄이다) → demand(요구하다): 늘어나는 인구는 더 많은 식량을 '요구'한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① innovations: 원문 일치
✅ ② productivity: 원문 일치
❌ ③ reduce: 원문은 demand — 반의어
✅ ④ influence: 원문 일치
det.tip: demand(요구하다) ↔ reduce(줄이다). 인구 증가 → 식량 수요 증가

questions.passage: It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to ①<u>rise</u> by at least 70%. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is ②<u>suitable</u> for farming due to ③<u>advantages</u> such as climate, topography, and soil quality. The amount of land used for agriculture has been ④<u>declining</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ advantages(장점) → limitations(한계): 기후, 지형, 토양 등은 농업의 '한계' 요인.
det.analysis:
✅ ① rise(증가): 원문 일치
✅ ② suitable(적합한): 원문 일치
❌ ③ advantages(장점): 원문은 limitations(한계) — 반의어
✅ ④ declining(감소하는): 원문 일치
det.tip: limitations(한계, 제한) ↔ advantages(장점). 기후/지형/토양 = 제한 요인

questions.passage: Over the millennia, continuous innovations have ①<u>boosted</u> agricultural productivity while ②<u>increasing</u> manual labor. The growing population will demand more food. Political factors, including land ownership, environmental laws, and population ③<u>density</u>, also influence agricultural land use. The amount of land for agriculture has been ④<u>declining</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② increasing(증가시키는) → reducing(줄이는): 혁신은 수작업을 '줄이면서' 생산성을 높였다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① boosted(높인): 원문 일치
❌ ② increasing(증가시키는): 원문은 reducing(줄이는) — 반의어
✅ ③ density(밀도): 원문 일치
✅ ④ declining(감소하는): 원문 일치
det.tip: reducing(줄이는) ↔ increasing(증가시키는). 혁신 → 노동 감소 + 생산성 증가

questions.passage: __________ evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 고고학적(Archaeological) 증거가 작물 재배의 기원을 알려준다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ Archaeological(고고학적): 고대 유물/유적 기반 증거
❌ ① Mathematical(수학적): 다른 분야
❌ ② Musical(음악적): 다른 분야
❌ ④ Astronomical(천문학적): 다른 분야
det.tip: archaeological = 고고학적. archaeology(고고학) + -ical(형용사)

questions.passage: Only a small portion of the Earth's surface is __________ for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 지구 표면의 작은 부분만이 농업에 적합(suitable)하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ suitable(적합한): 기후, 지형 등 제한으로 농경 적합지 제한
❌ ① dangerous(위험한): 문맥과 다름
❌ ② unnecessary(불필요한): 문맥과 다름
❌ ③ identical(동일한): 문맥과 다름
det.tip: suitable for = ~에 적합한. 기후/지형/토양 등이 제한 요인

questions.passage: It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 식량 생산이 수요(demand)를 충족하기 위해 70% 이상 증가해야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② demand(수요): 97억 인구의 식량 수요
❌ ① supply(공급): 충족 대상은 수요
❌ ③ standards(기준): 문맥과 다름
❌ ④ regulations(규제): 문맥과 다름
det.tip: meet demand = 수요를 충족하다. demand(수요) ↔ supply(공급)

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant. (A) Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991. (B) It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology. (C) Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: cultivated = 재배된, grown = 재배된 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ① grown(재배된): cultivated의 동의어
❌ ② destroyed(파괴된): 반의어
❌ ③ purchased(구매된): 다른 의미
❌ ④ abandoned(버려진): 반의어
det.tip: cultivated = grown = farmed = 재배된

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant. (A) Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991. (B) It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology. (C) Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: boosted = 높인, increased = 증가시킨 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ③ increased(증가시킨): boosted의 동의어
❌ ① decreased(감소시킨): 반의어
❌ ② hindered(방해한): 반의어
❌ ④ replaced(대체한): 다른 의미
det.tip: boosted = increased = enhanced = raised = 높인, 증가시킨

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant. (A) Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991. (B) It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology. (C) Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: projected = 전망된, estimated = 예측된 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ② estimated(예측된): projected의 동의어
❌ ① rejected(거부된): 다른 의미
❌ ③ confirmed(확인된): 전망 ≠ 확정
❌ ④ prohibited(금지된): 다른 의미
det.tip: projected = estimated = forecast = predicted = 전망된, 예측된

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant. (A) Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991. (B) It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology. (C) Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: declining = 감소하는 ↔ expanding = 확대하는
det.analysis:
❌ ④ expanding(확대하는): declining의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ① decreasing(감소하는): 동의어
✅ ② shrinking(줄어드는): 동의어
✅ ③ diminishing(감소하는): 동의어
det.tip: declining = decreasing = shrinking ↔ expanding = growing = increasing

questions.passage: Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being cultivated as early as 9500 BC in the Levant. (A) Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use. In fact, the amount of land used for agriculture has been declining. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used for food production, compared to 19.5 million square miles in 1991. (B) It is projected that by 2050, the world's population will increase to 9.7 billion, which will require global food production to rise by at least 70% to meet demand. Despite this need, only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations such as climate, topography, soil quality, and technology. (C) Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: suitable = 적합한 ↔ inappropriate = 부적절한
det.analysis:
❌ ① inappropriate(부적절한): suitable의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ② fitting(적합한): 동의어
✅ ③ appropriate(적절한): 동의어
✅ ④ proper(적당한): 동의어
det.tip: suitable = appropriate = fitting ↔ inappropriate = unsuitable

questions.passage: Political and economic factors, including land ownership patterns, environmental laws, and population density, also influence agricultural land use.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: density = 밀도, 인구 밀집도. population density = 인구 밀도.
det.analysis:
✅ ② the number of people per unit area(단위 면적당 인구수): 이 맥락에서의 의미
❌ ① thickness of a material(재료 두께): 물리적 의미
❌ ③ heaviness of an object(물체 무게): 다른 의미
❌ ④ darkness of a color(색의 진함): 다른 의미
det.tip: population density = 인구 밀도. density: ① 밀도(물리) ② 밀집도(인구)

ch: the number of people per unit area

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the rate of output per unit of input, especially in farming or industry"

det.korean: 투입 대비 산출 비율 = productivity(생산성)
det.analysis:
✅ ③ productivity(생산성): 영영풀이와 일치
❌ ① diversity(다양성): 다른 의미
❌ ② popularity(인기): 다른 의미
❌ ④ sensitivity(민감성): 다른 의미
det.tip: productivity = output per input = 생산성. productive(생산적인)

questions.passage: Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing manual labor.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸어 쓰시오.

Continuous (innovate) have boosted agricultural productivity.

det.korean: 동사 innovate를 명사 innovations로 변환. 복수 주어 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ innovations: innovate(동사) → innovation(명사) → innovations(복수)
det.tip: innovate(혁신하다) → innovation(혁신) → innovations(복수)

questions.passage: Only a small portion of the Earth's surface is suitable for farming due to limitations.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸어 쓰시오.

Archaeological evidence suggests that various crops were being (cultivate) as early as 9500 BC.

det.korean: 동사 cultivate를 과거분사 cultivated로 변환. were being + p.p. = 과거진행 수동태.
det.analysis: ✅ cultivated: were being cultivated(과거진행수동)
det.tip: were being + p.p. = 과거 진행 수동태. cultivate → cultivated

questions.passage: The amount of land used for agriculture has been __________. In 2013, around 18.6 million square miles was used, compared to 19.5 million in 1991.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 농업용 토지가 감소(declining)하고 있다. 2013년(18.6M) < 1991년(19.5M).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ declining(감소하는): 19.5 → 18.6 = 감소
❌ ① expanding(확대하는): 반대
❌ ② doubling(두 배 증가): 반대
❌ ③ stabilizing(안정화): 감소 추세
det.tip: declining = decreasing. 19.5M(1991) → 18.6M(2013) = 약 0.9M 감소

questions.passage: Over the millennia, continuous innovations have boosted agricultural productivity while reducing __________ labor.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 혁신이 수작업(manual) 노동을 줄였다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① manual(수작업의): 원문 일치
❌ ② mental(정신적): 다른 의미
❌ ③ emotional(감정적): 다른 의미
❌ ④ digital(디지털): 시대에 맞지 않음
det.tip: manual labor = 수작업 노동, 육체 노동. manual(손으로 하는)
